text: dsh-pet-sprite 是面向 DSH Web 的互动像素桌宠，挂在聊天界面中，可在消息气泡间自动跳跃，也能由用户用键盘接管。点击角色可使用已配置的 DSH 模型进行宠物口吻对话；照料面板提供状态、互动、背包、商店和设置。用户还可生成、导入并分享自定义像素伙伴，记录工作记忆，并在设备间同步宠物进度。适合想在编程会话中加入轻量陪伴和小游戏的 DSH Web 用户；聊天与生成使用 DSH 已选模型，不需另配插件 API 密钥。

dsh-pet-sprite adds a pixel pet to DSH Web chat. It jumps across message bubbles and supports keyboard control. Click it to chat through your selected DSH model; the care panel manages pet stats and items. Generate, import, and share custom pets, save work memories, and sync progress across devices.
想在 DSH 的聊天界面里养一只会动的像素宠物。
有没有能把聊天消息气泡当平台跳来跳去的小挂件？
我想点击桌宠就能用已经配置好的模型和它聊天。
能不能自己描述角色，让模型生成一个像素小伙伴？
我想导入朋友分享的桌宠文件，也把自己的导出去。
想让宠物记住我最近的工作，并在不同设备间保留进度。
I want a small pixel companion that lives in my DSH chat window.
Can I chat with a virtual pet using the model I already selected in DSH?
dsh-pet-sprite 的功能「宠物对话」：点击桌宠打开聊天框，消息连同近期上下文、角色设定和所选 DSH 模型发给插件路由，再以宠物回复显示并保留最近对话。
dsh-pet-sprite 的功能「自定义伙伴」：用户输入角色描述后，所选模型生成像素网格与角色信息；插件校验网格后保存为自定义桌宠，也可导入或导出分享文件。
dsh-pet-sprite 的功能「平台跳跃与照料」：宠物在聊天区消息气泡间自主移动，用户可接管操控；照料面板可查看状态并进行互动、管理物品和商店。
dsh-pet-sprite 的功能「工作记忆与同步」：可从近期会话提炼少量关于用户的记忆，并在浏览器本地保存；状态变化会同步到 DSH 主机，启动时可恢复较新的设备状态。
dsh-pet-sprite 会将宠物聊天内容、近期会话片段或角色描述交给用户选定的 DSH 模型处理；跨设备进度和共享记忆也会写入 DSH 主机存储。
dsh-pet-sprite 提供工具 pet_memory_list：列出宠物对主人的全部记忆（每条：内容 + 来源会话 + 时间）。宠物在用户工作时旁观察到的持久事实；跨会话可用。
dsh-pet-sprite 提供工具 pet_memory_search：按关键词检索宠物记忆（多关键词 AND）。先查这个再决定是否需要 pet_memory_list 全量。
dsh-pet-sprite 提供工具 pet_memory_write：给宠物写一条关于主人的新记忆（≤60字）。用户说「让宠物记住…」或 agent 判断有跨会话价值的持久事实时使用；重复事实会被去重拒绝。

dsh-pet-sprite README · dsh-pet-sprite：A **playable** pixel companion plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI.

Not a wallpaper mascot — the pet lives in your chat area, **platform-jumps over your message bubbles**, and you can grab the controls yourself. It also carries a full nurture system fed by your agent's **real token usage**.

dsh-pet-sprite README · Features：- **Three companions, one egg** — on first launch a speckled egg wobbles quietly in the corner (never a forced popup). Click it to hatch and pick your companion: **Poka** the white-haired girl, **Mikan** the tabby cat, or **Puff** the DeepSeek-blue baby whale. Switch anytime from the care panel.
- **Generate & share your own companion** — describe it in one sentence ("a green dino with round glasses") and the model draws a new pixel sprite for 100 star coins, animated automatically. Every generated pet exports as a `.dsh-pet.json` file friends can import for free.
- **Left-click to chat** — clicking the pet opens a small chat box beside it. Replies come from the model you already configured in DSH (provider + model pickable in the care panel's settings tab), so it reuses your existing credentials — no extra API key. The pet answers in-character as a speech bubble; the last 30 turns persist locally.
- **Platform jumping playground** — the pet treats chat message bubbles as platforms: it wanders, climbs bubble edges, hops between messages on its own.

dsh-pet-sprite README · Features：Right-click the pet to open the care panel (status / interactions / inventory / shop / settings), docked right next to the character.

dsh-pet-sprite README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite
```

Then restart DSH (`dsh web`) and open any conversation — the pet spawns at the bottom of the chat flow.

> `lib/` build output is committed, so git installs work without authorizing build scripts. To rebuild from source: `pnpm install && pnpm build`.

dsh-pet-sprite README · How it works：- Registers into the DSH Web UI `shell.overlay` slot via the `dsh.client` browser-plugin manifest.
- The node half mounts two exact HTTP routes (`GET /plugins/dsh-pet-sprite/models`, `POST /plugins/dsh-pet-sprite/chat`) that proxy `ctx.llm` — the same LLM runtime the coding agent uses, with your configured providers and keys.
- Platforms are discovered from `[data-chat-flow-key]` message nodes; the arena is the conversation scroll viewport. Everything adapts live to scrolling and new messages.
- Game state and chat history (attributes, level, coins, inventory, last 30 chat turns, model choice) persist in `localStorage` — no telemetry, zero external network calls.

dsh-pet-sprite README · Compatibility：- DSH developer preview (tested against `0.1.0-rc.7`). DSH is iterating fast with breaking changes; pin a commit (`github:<you>/dsh-pet-sprite#<sha>`) if stability matters.
